title: Imperium Mod
description: An adventure mod that adds items, cursed weapons, custom advancements, a new enchantment, and secrets to discover.
body:
![imperium tab](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae64dc40fee037ab2ecf53fd4c90b48d2d290fd1.png)

**Imperium** is an adventure and progression mod that adds new content inspired by the lore of an ancient empire.

It was originally created for a private server with friends, where the mod was part of the world’s story and its characters. I vibecoded it in my free time as a personal project for that server, but now it is publicly available so any player can try it, explore it, and adapt its content to their own world.

Although part of the lore was born inside that server, the mod also works as a standalone Minecraft expansion, adding special items, unique weapons, custom advancements, and hidden rewards.

![Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LEcEBFDY/images/7bebbd1952a7a9eb94df0aabe31ff6d32be3d9d0.png)

## What does it add?

- New weapons and items related to the Empire.
- The **Imperial Sword**, a special weapon tied to exploration.
- The **Imperial Totem**, capable of protecting the player from death.
- The **Monarch’s Amulet**, an item connected to the legacy of the First Monarch.
- Cursed swords and content related to the Blood Curse.
- Custom advancements with experience rewards.
- Hidden secrets for players who want to discover all the content.

![Monarch’s Blessing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fb6eff8c13d6352c1f60822f72f65efc4218b25.png)

## About the lore

The mod is based on a story created for a server with friends, so some names, items, or advancements may feel more narrative than in a traditional mod.

The main idea revolves around the Empire, the legacy of the First Monarch, ancient weapons, broken oaths, and relics with special power.

You do not need to know the original lore to play it. The mod is designed so you can enjoy it as a small adventure, exploration, and reward-based expansion.
